label: lem:topological-mass-eigenspace-decomp
title: Eigenspace decomposition of the mass integrand (descent involution)
html:
Let \alpha = (\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+) form the integrand of the mass identity for a vortex \varrho. Let \hat{\tau}_n be the descent involution. The Killing-form orthogonality of \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{desc}} \oplus \mathcal{A}_{n+1}^{\mathrm{trans}} together with multiplicative-integral additivity over orthogonal direct sums yields:

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  =
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)
  \bigr\rVert
  +
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma
  \bigl(\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)\bigr)
  \bigr\rVert.
heading: Lemma
